annotation.evidence_span: MUST only make use of Alt-Svc when operating in SVCB-optional mode
annotation.interpretation_a: Clients MUST use Alt-Svc only if a specific SVCB-optional mode is explicitly enabled or configured.
annotation.interpretation_b: Clients MUST use Alt-Svc unless a specific SVCB-optional mode is explicitly disabled or configured.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'when operating in SVCB-optional mode' is incomplete. It doesn't specify whether this mode is an enabled or disabled state. This leads to two reasonable interpretations of when Alt-Svc should be used.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'SVCB-optional mode' is not provided in the target clause, and the reference [ech-client-behavior] is not supplied. Without knowing how 'SVCB-optional mode' is determined, it is unclear whether the client should use Alt-Svc by default and disable it in this mode, or vice versa.
